Прочитай текст: Scotland has castles, hills and many lakes called lochs. Its capital is Edinburgh . Bagpipes are a traditional musical instrument, and a kilt is a traditional item of clothing. Loch Ness is famous for a monster legend. A travel text can describe the scenery and traditions while making clear that a legend is a story people tell.
